method: Frozen PCA of the standardized full-dimensional featurization, fit once over the whole 8-member base_id library with no access to any outcome. Component count from the Kneedle knee of the explained-variance curve.
none_location: No-base rows are zero-filled at assembly. PC scores are centred, so the zero vector is the centroid of the 8 bases in PC space rather than a point no base occupies. KS2-KS4 mask the base block through base_active; KS1 sees no-base rows at that centroid.
